sara nguyen: Heads-up — running into weird edgecases when mapping tenancy/observability across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Can we sync? :wave:

tom harris: sure. what's the concrete problematic flow?

sara nguyen: two things: 1) metric/billing tags that need to be immutable for hosted but may be customer-controlled in private. 2) KMS key handling + sealed secrets across adapters.

benji: +1. Also feature flags: private deploys sometimes run older control plane, so our rollout flags can't be centralised.

kevin: For metrics: propose canonical tag set that our routing layers attach, then allow customer tags as optional metadata. billing uses canonical only.

sara nguyen: i like canonical tag idea. how do we enforce immutability in Dedicated where infra team might change headers?

tom harris: put canonical tags in a signed header from control plane. runtime validates signature. If missing, mark as untrusted and route to audit queue.

benji: signed header works but KMS scope differs. private deployments may use customer KMS not ours => signature verification needs pluggable verifier.

kevin: exactly. we need an AdapterVerifier interface: verify(header, tenantID) -> bool. default uses redwood-kms; private uses tenant-provided verifier plugin.

ops-bot: Deploy Bot: canary rollout for adapter-verifier v2 started on eng-dedicated, id=canary-2026-03-19T12:34Z :rocket:

sara nguyen: example header format:
```
X-RW-Canonical: t=tenant123;v=1;sig=BASE64SIG
```
Runtime validation pseudocode:
```
if !verifier.verify(hdr, tenant): reject(403, "unverified-canonical")
```

tom harris: fallback modes? we can't break existing private installs on upgrade.

benji: fallback config per-deploy: {"mode":"enforce"|"log-only"|"disabled"}. default: log-only for first 2 major releases.

kevin: metrics emission: include tags: [tenant_id, hosting_mode, model_variant]. hosting_mode = hosted|dedicated|private

sara nguyen: ops note: audit trail must include verifier version + KMS key id. otherwise compliance can't prove signing.

benji: open question: how to surface to customers that billing only uses canonical tag. doc + console flag per-tenant.

tom harris: action items:
- tom: draft AdapterVerifier interface + fallback config (PR)
- benji: KMS plugin spec + migration notes for existing private installs
- kevin: metrics tagging RFC + dashboard changes for billing teams
- sara: write short RFC followup summarising these decisions

sara nguyen: i'll follow up with a 1-pager and link here. thx all :heart:
